title: Guest Lamp
summary: Start: enter Guest Lamp. The log opens the job and the helm marks the Lamp Host. Do: come within 320 meters of the Lamp Host. The host slides alongside and reads the lamp paper. An interceptor holds the lane. The navy escort stays with the host. Finish: after the host is met, come inside Guest Station's shell. The navy writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
